name: Gizmos with a friend
summary: When a friend joins your room, they see the same triggers, effects, seats and beats you have. When something happens on your side, it happens on theirs a moment later.
helps: Greet a friend at the door, with the wave and the voice in step with you, and know they cannot change or keep your scene.
where2d: Atelier and BSA, right panel, Settings: Gizmos live.

d2: Build your scene with triggers, effects and beats.
Invite a friend. They see your scene after a few seconds.
When they walk into a trigger, it greets them.
vr: Open the wrist menu and press Settings, then Gizmos live.
Invite a friend through the guest door.
Stand back and watch the trigger greet them.
use: you decide everything and your friend follows
your friend sees the greeting within a third of a second of you
a seat you are sitting in shows as taken for your friend
your friend cannot save, export or download your scene
nothing is sent in a private project

changes.note: Your friend now sees your triggers, effects, seats and beats when they join, and sees a greeting start in step with you, so turn Gizmos live on and invite them.
